content_fields.title: Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for container orchestration
content_fields.description: Implement role-based access control for the container orchestration platform.
content_fields.guidance: Orchestration permissions should be granted through roles bound to groups, with separate roles for deploy, read and administrative operations, and no standing cluster-administrator access.
content_fields.found: Deployment is driven by shell scripts invoking Docker Compose on the host; anyone with Docker socket access has full control.
content_fields.missing: An orchestration platform with an authorization model, and a directory to bind roles to.
content_fields.conclusion: There is no orchestration authorization layer in this deployment to configure.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should implement orchestration RBAC when the service is deployed to a managed platform.
